Name: Schwarzwaldhochstraße & Mummelsee
Tip: Go early in the morning or on a weekday – on summer weekends the road is busy.

Name: Hornisgrinde – highest peak of the northern Black Forest
Tip: Combine it with the Mummelsee stop and plan two to three hours.

Name: Titisee & Feldberg
Tip: Start at the Feldberg early and drive to Titisee in the afternoon – it is still bearable there then.

Name: Baden-Baden
Tip: Start in Baden-Baden and drive the High Road the next morning.

Name: Triberg: cuckoo clocks & Black Forest cake
Tip: Combine waterfalls, clocks and cake in one day – everything is close together.

Name: Gengenbach – half-timbered town
Tip: In December come early and enjoy the atmosphere; otherwise on a weekend, when everything is open.

Name: Vogtsbauernhof Open-Air Museum (Gutach)
Tip: Plan it for a rainy day or a hot day – there is lots of shade and roofs.

Name: Triberg Waterfalls
Tip: Come early in the morning or late in the afternoon, then fewer people are there and the squirrels are more active.

Name: Ravenna Gorge & Viaduct
Tip: Go in the morning – then the path is empty and the sun shines into the valley.

Name: Wutach Gorge – wilderness in the southern Black Forest
Tip: Start early, take water and snacks and check closed sections beforehand.

Name: Treetop Walk Bad Wildbad
Tip: Come in the morning and combine it with the High Road.

Name: Menzenschwand waterfalls
Tip: Wear grippy shoes – the walkways are slippery after rain.
